INSERT INTO $framework.NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING (title, earning_group, category, sub_category)
SELECT
    t.title,
    e.identifier,
    t.category,
    e.sub_category
FROM $framework.NATERA_TITLE_CATEGORY_MAPPING t
INNER JOIN $framework.NATERA_MAPPING_MAIN e
    ON t.category = e.category
ORDER BY t.category ASC, t.title ASC, e.identifier ASC;
